zh: 上个月我们终于还清了车贷。
en: We finally {paid off|repaid|cleared|paid back} the car loan last month.

zh: 我正在攒钱付房子的首付。
en: I'm {saving up for|saving for} a house deposit.

zh: 他借的钱到现在还没还。
en: He still hasn't {paid back|repaid|returned|given back} the money he borrowed.

zh: 现在只有一份收入，我们得缩减开支。
en: We need to {cut back|cut down|save|budget|economise|economize} now that we're on one income.

zh: 他们办了房贷买了第一套房子。
en: They {took out|got} a mortgage to buy their first home.

zh: 她每次发工资都留出一百块以备急用。
en: She {sets aside|puts aside|puts away|saves|keeps} a hundred dollars every payday for emergencies.

zh: 今年房租又涨了。
en: Rent has {gone up|increased|risen} again this year.

zh: 油价终于降了一点。
en: Petrol prices have finally {come down|gone down|dropped|fallen|eased} a bit.

zh: 圣诞节期间他刷出了一大笔信用卡账单。
en: He {ran up|racked up|built up|got} a huge credit card bill over Christmas.

zh: 在奥克兰靠一份收入很难过日子。
en: It's hard to {get by|live|survive|manage|cope} on one income in Auckland.

zh: 我们被那个出租车司机宰了。
en: We got {ripped off|overcharged|cheated|scammed|robbed} by that taxi driver.

zh: 我不得不掏八百块钱换新轮胎。
en: I had to {fork out|shell out|pay|cough up|spend|find} eight hundred dollars for new tyres.

zh: 我的雇主每个月都往我的KiwiSaver里存钱。
en: My employer {pays into|contributes to} my KiwiSaver every month.

zh: 我在算我欠多少税。
en: I'm trying to {work out|figure out|calculate|find out|see|check} how much tax I owe.

zh: 坐公交之前我得给我的Hop卡充值。
en: I need to {top up|load|recharge|reload|put money on} my Hop card before I catch the bus.

zh: 我们不得不动用积蓄来修屋顶。
en: We had to {dip into|use|spend|break into|draw on|tap into} our savings to fix the roof.

zh: 房东把房租每周涨了五十块。
en: The landlord has {put up|raised|increased|lifted|bumped up|pushed up|hiked} the rent by fifty dollars a week.

zh: 保险公司一周之内就赔付了。
en: The insurance company {paid out|paid up|paid|settled} within a week.

zh: 这个副业每个月能带来大约五百块的收入。
en: The side business {brings in|makes|earns|generates|pulls in} about five hundred dollars a month.

zh: 我需要查一下机票多少钱。
en: I need to {find out|check|see|know|work out|figure out|look up} how much the flight costs.
